name: Sleep Reset
short_description: Clinically proven CBT-I digital program for insomnia with personalized coaching from real human sleep therapists, developed by Stanford and Yale researchers.
long_description: Sleep Reset is a clinically proven Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) based digital program developed by Stanford and Yale sleep researchers, recommended by over 860 doctors. The platform provides an 8-12 week personalized protocol addressing the beliefs and behaviors behind insomnia using techniques like Sleep Restriction, Stimulus Control, and Relaxation Training. Unlike bot-based apps, Sleep Reset offers real human sleep therapists and coaches providing 1:1 messaging support for guidance and accountability. The program includes an in-depth sleep assessment, short daily lessons and exercises, and ongoing coaching. Members report 85 more minutes of sleep nightly, 53% less time to fall asleep, 41% less time awake at night, and 2 fewer nightly awakenings, with clinically proven improvement starting in 2 weeks.
one_liner: CBT-I insomnia program with real human sleep coaches
best_for: Sleep medicine specialists and primary care providers recommending evidence-based insomnia treatment for patients who prefer coaching-supported digital CBT-I
not_for: Patients with sleep apnea requiring CPAP (though at-home testing available)

pricing.notes: HSA/FSA eligible. $19 one-week trial, program costs $229-$299. At-home apnea testing $189, clinician visits $149 with major insurance accepted.

outcomes.fall_asleep_faster: 53% reduction in time to fall asleep
